episodes.title: Welcome to Spiderwick
episodes.summary: Helen Grace and her children move to their ancestral home, Spiderwick.

episodes.title: The Field Guide to the Fantastical World Around You
episodes.summary: Jared sets traps for the creature in his house, while Helen leads the search for Aunt Lucinda.

episodes.title: I Will Survive
episodes.summary: Jared grows paranoid of the evil force conspiring to get Spiderwick's Field Guide.

episodes.title: Tastes Like Chicken
episodes.summary: A divide between the twins widens as they split up with Emiko and Hatcher to find more pages.

episodes.title: A Midsummer's Daydream
episodes.summary: Simon goes to his father for help; Calliope takes Simon to a friend; Jared has to find a page.

episodes.title: 1028 Teeth
episodes.summary: Mallory and Jared team up to find the Vorpal Sword, the only weapon that can stop Mulgarath.

episodes.title: The Field Guide to Jared Grace
episodes.summary: Held captive at Meskwaki, Jared holds his own against the ogre as Mulgarath pressures him.

episodes.title: The Wrath of Mulgarath
episodes.summary: The gang launches a daring plan to rescue Jared; the Grace family must reunite to defeat Mulgarath.
